confirm.deleteDescription: The draft and the photos and video uploaded to it are deleted. This can't be undone.
confirm.deleteArchivedDescription: The recipe, its photos, video and versions are deleted, and it disappears from the favorites and lists of anyone who saved it. A recipe in a program or already completed by someone can't be deleted. This can't be undone.
confirm.archiveDescription: The recipe goes offline and leaves your main list. You can restore it later; it comes back as a draft.
confirm.unpublishDescription: The recipe goes offline and back to draft so you can edit it. Publishing again goes through the checklist.
confirm.withdrawDescription: The review round is closed and the recipe goes back to an editable draft.

done.unpublished: Recipe unpublished. It is now a draft.

validation.unitNeedsAmount: Enter the amount to use a unit.
validation.unitNeedsNumber: With a unit, the amount must be a number (e.g. 1/2 or 1.5).

basics.title: Title
basics.summaryHint: One or two sentences: shown on the card and at the top of the recipe.
basics.storyHint: Optional: where it comes from, who it is for, what makes it special.
basics.yieldHintOther: Optional. A few words, e.g. 1 medium dish.
basics.servingsHint: How many people the recipe serves. Required to publish. Cooks can change it and the ingredients adjust automatically.
basics.timesHint: Fill in only what the recipe has. Leave blank what doesn't apply.
basics.cookHint: On the stove, in the oven or air fryer.
basics.totalHint: Calculated for you: prep + cooking + resting = {sum}. Increase it if there's any extra wait.
basics.totalHintEmpty: Calculated for you once you fill in the times above.
basics.timesWarning: The total is less than prep + cooking + resting ({sum} min): fix it before publishing.

ingredients.name: Name
ingredients.amountHint: No unit: a number (2, 1/2) or free text.
ingredients.amountHintDecimal: Weight or volume: numbers only, e.g. 200 or 1.5.
ingredients.amountHintFraction: Whole number or fraction, e.g. 2, 1/2 or 1 1/2. Use the shortcuts for fractions.
ingredients.textHint: Free text: doesn't scale with servings.
ingredients.notePlaceholder: E.g. chopped, medium, at room temperature
ingredients.substitutionsHint: Up to 5 alternatives for this ingredient.

prep.imageHint: Upload the photo here; it only shows to people who can open the recipe.

media.videoNotConfigured: Video upload isn't set up yet: ask the administrator to enable Cloudflare Stream.

items.title: Title: write the recipe name.
items.summary: Description: write one or two sentences about the recipe.

items.gallery_alt: Alt text: every Gallery photo needs to say what it shows.
items.servings: Servings: say how many people the recipe serves.
items.total_minutes: Times: fill in at least one (prep, cooking or resting).
items.times: Total time: it's less than the sum of the times. Increase it or tap “Back to the calculation”.
items.ingredients: Ingredients: add at least one, with a name.
items.steps: Method: add at least one step saying what to do.
items.allergens: Allergens: choose “No allergens” or “Contains allergens” and pick which.
items.license: License: pick a license that matches the video you added.
items.stream: Video: the previous upload is no longer valid. Upload it again or remove it.

versions.notEditable: Unpublish or withdraw from review to restore.
